GSM.title: Ferroglobe Comments on European Commission's Initiation of Interim Review of Antidumping Measures on Chinese Silicon Metal Imports
GSM.summary: The European Commission has initiated an interim review of antidumping duties on silicon metal imports from China, following a request by Euroalliages on behalf of the EU silicon metal industry. The investigation will examine whether Chinese silicon metal has been sold at unfair prices and caused material injury to EU producers. Ferroglobe views this as a positive step toward fair competition and market protection in Europe's silicon metal sector.

SNEX.title: StoneX to Offer Milk Price Risk Management Solutions to Retail Dairy Farmers in New Zealand
SNEX.summary: StoneX Financial Pty Ltd has received approval from New Zealand's Financial Markets Authority to offer milk price risk management solutions to dairy farmers and sharemilkers. The company has developed a user-friendly digital platform to help producers manage exposure to milk price volatility and improve income certainty, marking a significant expansion of StoneX's agricultural hedging capabilities in one of the world's largest dairy-producing markets.

AIRS.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of AirSculpt Technologies, Inc. - AIRS
AIRS.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating AirSculpt Technologies for potential securities fraud following the company's announcement of declining quarterly revenue ($42.9M vs $44.0M year-over-year) on August 10, 2026. The news triggered a significant stock price decline of 45.11%, falling from $5.01 to $2.75 per share.

BRCB.title: Black Rock Coffee Bar Continues Expansion in California with New Lake Elsinore Location
BRCB.summary: Black Rock Coffee Bar, an Oregon-based boutique coffee chain, opened its sixth California location in Lake Elsinore on September 2, 2026. The expansion reflects the company's steady growth across California and reinforces its national presence with over 200 retail locations across seven states.

CSWC.title: Capital Southwest Announces Shareholder Approval of Proposal to Increase Authorized Shares
CSWC.summary: Capital Southwest Corporation (Nasdaq: CSWC) announced that shareholders voted to approve an increase in authorized common stock shares from 75.0 million to 135.0 million at the company's reconvened annual meeting. CEO Michael S. Sarner stated the approval provides flexibility for funding new investments, maintaining a conservative balance sheet, and creating long-term shareholder value.

RLAY.title: Relay Therapeutics to Participate in Two Upcoming Investor Conferences in September
RLAY.summary: Relay Therapeutics announced that management will participate in fireside chats at the Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference on September 8, 2026 and the Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference on September 16, 2026. The clinical-stage precision medicine company is developing therapies for cancer and genetic diseases, with its lead asset zovegalisib currently in Phase 3 trials for HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer.

AARD.title: Deadline Alert: Aardvark Therapeutics, Inc. (AARD) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
AARD.summary: Aardvark Therapeutics faces a securities fraud class action lawsuit covering the period February 10, 2025 to May 14, 2026. The company voluntarily paused its Phase 3 HERO trial in February 2026 due to cardiac safety concerns, causing a 56.2% stock decline. In May 2026, the FDA placed a full clinical hold on the drug ARD-101, resulting in a further 32.1% stock drop. Investors are urged to file lead plaintiff motions by October 13, 2026.

ACMR.title: Is the Options Market Predicting a Spike in ACM Research Stock?
ACMR.summary: ACM Research (ACMR) is drawing attention from options traders due to high implied volatility in its Jan. 15, 2027 $32 Call options, suggesting investors expect significant price movement. The company holds a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating, with analysts recently raising earnings estimates for the current quarter from 40 cents to 57 cents per share over the last 30 days.

IPSAY.title: Ipsos: Disclosure of trading in own shares under a share buyback programme (25 to 28 August 2026)
IPSAY.summary: Ipsos disclosed its share buyback activities for the period of 25-28 August 2026, reporting aggregated trading data across multiple trading venues (XETRA and Euronext). The company repurchased a total of 54,177 shares at weighted average prices ranging from €39.29 to €39.78 per share across the four trading days.

IPSAY.title: Ipsos : Communiqué relatif aux rachats d’actions propres (25 au 28 août 2026)
IPSAY.summary: Ipsos disclosed its share buyback activity for the period of August 25-28, 2026. The company repurchased a total of 58,097 shares across Euronext Paris (XPAR) and Euronext Brussels (CEUX) markets at weighted average prices ranging from €39.29 to €39.79 per share.

ETST.title: Earth Science Tech, Inc. Announces 2026 Annual Shareholder Meeting Results
ETST.summary: Earth Science Tech, Inc. (OTC: ETST) announced voting results from its first Annual Meeting of Stockholders held on August 31, 2026. Shareholders approved a reverse stock split strategy for potential uplisting, authorized retirement of Series B Preferred Stock to eliminate dual-class voting structure, and approved non-dilutive cash-only executive compensation. All seven board directors were re-elected and the independent auditor was ratified.

TILL.title: Agricultural ETF (TAGS) Touches New 52-Week High
TILL.summary: Teucrium Agricultural ETF (TAGS) has reached a 52-week high, rising 25.7% from its low, driven by severe weather disruptions in key growing regions, geopolitical risks in export hubs, and rising global demand. The fund, which tracks corn, wheat, soybeans, and sugar, shows positive momentum with a weighted alpha of 26.59, suggesting potential for continued gains in the near term.

TMO.title: TMO Stock Could Gain Following the Launch of EMPAD G2 Detector
TMO.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific unveiled the EMPAD G2 detector, enabling faster 4D STEM materials analysis at 10,000 frames per second with atomic-scale characterization. The detector integrates with Velox software for simplified analysis. The global 4D STEM market is projected to grow from $68 million in 2024 to $110 million by 2031 at a 6.6% CAGR, supporting TMO's growth prospects in analytical instruments.

LNC.title: Aon's $17 Billion USI Deal: A Costly Bet on Middle-Market Growth
LNC.summary: Aon is acquiring USI Insurance Services from KKR for $17 billion to expand its U.S. middle-market insurance brokerage footprint. The deal, expected to close in Q4 2026, will add specialty insurance access and analytics capabilities while generating approximately $395 million in annual EBITDA synergies. EPS accretion is projected for 2028, though the transaction requires significant debt financing and suspension of share repurchases in the near term.

MPWR.summary: Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) has surged 53.9% over the past year, outperforming its industry peers, driven by strong demand for AI and cloud power solutions. DINO.title: HF Sinclair Plans Lubricants Spin-Off: Is it a Value-Unlocking Move?
DINO.summary: HF Sinclair (DINO) plans to spin off its Lubricants & Specialties division into an independent public company by late 2027, aiming to reduce capital competition and improve strategic focus on core refining, midstream, and renewables businesses. The separation includes retiring the Mississauga refinery and shifting to a capital-light lubricants model. Meanwhile, energy majors Eni and Shell are simplifying portfolios through asset sales and restructuring to unlock value and improve capital allocation.

E.title: Eni Builds Uruguay Offshore Presence Through New Exploration Deals
E.summary: Eni has signed agreements to expand its presence in Uruguay's offshore exploration sector. The Italian energy company will operate the OFF-5 block with MIWEN (YPF subsidiary) holding 50%, and will acquire a 40% stake in the neighboring OFF-6 block operated by APA Corporation. Eni will fund a significant portion of an initial exploration well scheduled for 2027. These moves strengthen Eni's position in Latin America and diversify its upstream operations.

RDN.summary: Radian Group (RDN) is navigating softer specialty insurance pricing following its February 2026 acquisition of Inigo, which significantly expanded its specialty insurance and reinsurance exposure. INBX.title: Chondrosarcoma Clinical Trial Pipeline: Emerging Therapies and Key Developments Shaping the Treatment Landscape | DelveInsight
INBX.summary: DelveInsight released a comprehensive report on the chondrosarcoma clinical trial pipeline, highlighting 5+ emerging therapies in development by key players. Notable drugs include Ozekibart (INBRX-109) which received FDA acceptance for filing with a PDUFA goal date of April 2027, Ivosidenib in Phase III trials, and RBT-102 in preclinical stages. The pipeline focuses on novel mechanisms including DR5 agonism and IDH1 inhibition to address this rare, high-unmet-need oncology market.

NSRGY.title: Nestlé reaches agreement to divest its mainstream vitamins, minerals and supplements business
NSRGY.summary: Nestlé has agreed to sell its mainstream Vitamins, Minerals and Supplements (VMS) business, including seven established brands such as Nature's Bounty and Puritan's Pride, to Yellow Wood Partners for USD 1.0 billion. The transaction is expected to close by the first half of 2027. Nestlé will focus on premium, science-led VMS brands like Solgar and Pure Encapsulations, where it has stronger competitive advantages.

SGML.title: Sigma Expands Their Ultrafast T1.5 Aizu Large-Format Lens Series; More Info at B&H
SGML.summary: Sigma has expanded its Aizu Cinema Prime Lenses series with three new focal lengths (21mm, 100mm, and 125mm), bringing the total to 11 lenses. The new primes maintain the series' signature T1.3 aperture, 46.3mm image circle, and organic look, available in ARRI PL and Sony E mounts for full-frame and large-format cinema cameras.

TOL.title: Toll Brothers at Kresston Now Open in Montgomery, Texas
TOL.summary: Toll Brothers opened Toll Brothers at Kresston, a new luxury home community in Montgomery County, Texas, featuring six home designs ranging from 3,293 to 4,802 square feet priced from the low $700,000s. The community includes resort-style amenities such as a pool, splash pad, pickleball courts, and nature trails, with convenient access to Highway 249 and The Woodlands.

TOL.title: Toll Brothers Announces New Luxury Home Community Coming Soon to Horsham, Pennsylvania
TOL.summary: Toll Brothers announced Woodford Glen, a new luxury residential community in Horsham, Pennsylvania, featuring 22 single-family homes on one-acre sites priced from $1.6 million. The community is under site work with sales anticipated to begin in late fall 2026. Homes will range from 4,600 to 6,600 square feet with 4-5 bedrooms and modern amenities.

PM.title: Is Altria's on! PLUS Shaping Up as Its Next Major Growth Engine?
PM.summary: Altria's on! PLUS nicotine pouch product is gaining early momentum with retail presence expanding to approximately 120,000 stores and encouraging repeat purchase rates. Altria's stock has underperformed the industry over the past three months, trading at a lower valuation multiple.
